title: Prepare the Amadeus office pool (admin)
caption: Velexis staff set the shared account and offices that new OTAs get at provisioning.

steps.title: Account
steps.body: `POST /v1/admin/amadeus-accounts` (step-up) with environment, base URL, client id and secret; or rely on `dev:seed`.
steps.expect: `pending_verification` then `active` after `amadeus_account.verify`; secret only as ciphertext.

steps.title: Assign / release / retire
steps.expect: Status changes per the office lifecycle; vx:invalidate connection / amadeus_account.

steps.title: Pool level
steps.expect: `ops.alert` to OPS_ALERT_EMAIL when fewer than 3 offices are available in an environment.
